name: supply-chain
title: Supply chain
purpose: The venture's approved suppliers and its purchase orders, one supply-chain/suppliers/<id>.json and one supply-chain/purchase-orders/<id>.json each (ISO 9001:2015 clause 8.4; APQC PCF 4.2; Incoterms 2020). Only a venture that makes, buys or ships physical goods keeps it. The supply-chain function owns it, so the supply-chain agent gets its write routes. Never complete.
